summary: The command inventory document lists its conformance rules, purpose fields and canonical roots one entry per line, so two changes that add different commands no longer conflict

replay.detail: No replay, backfill, stored data or transcript change.

schema.detail: Published schema, operations and contract digest are unchanged.

rules.detail: No claim, checkpoint, retention or authority rule change. The inventory parses to the same JSON.

compatibility.detail: Nothing a client or peer sees changes.

downtime.detail: Ordinary rolling deployment; no data conversion or extra startup work.

recovery.detail: No recovery, durable payload or initialization changes.
